points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight canonical packages passed prior structural validation; seven steady force plots do not expose history, and transient strict updated-residual target is unverified.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit validator accepted eight packages and report; structural pass does not verify physical convergence or target residual with updated reconstruction.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All canonical packages validate structurally; seven steady statuses use documented frozen reconstruction, Re200 finishes t300 but strict updated-residual target count is not established.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Raw force tails and Re200 repeated crossings support plausible attempts; frozen reconstruction, transient target accounting and Re20 np1/8 difference limit accuracy confidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All seven steady force plots collapse at physical_time=0, not pseudo-step histories; Re200 startup drag compresses late drag. Case-specific fields/residual plots are present.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses frozen reconstruction and rank spread, but claims tangential integrated shear while code integrates full traction; steady force graphs do not show time evolution.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest maps canonical cases and figures; original metadata git_revision=null and inner target measures frozen residual, not proven accepted-state fully updated residual.
